notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
This is a small update, mainly to fix some grammatical errors (thanks to Rian) and to make sure that the internal achievement list matches the Steam achievement list.

In addition, the gender selection title/start game buttons are larger now.

The main update is still on schedule for the end of October
